bands.title: Pita 1
bands.knowledge: Kemampuan baca-tulis dan berhitung dasar; mempelajari tugas rutin sederhana sambil bekerja.
bands.autonomy: Mengikuti instruksi yang jelas; pekerjaannya sering diperiksa.

bands.title: Pita 2
bands.knowledge: Mengetahui rutinitas dan prosedur di bidang kerjanya; dapat memiliki kualifikasi tingkat awal.
bands.autonomy: Bekerja menurut prosedur yang ditetapkan, dengan penyelia yang siap membantu.
bands.leadership: Dapat menunjukkan tugas rutin kepada orang yang baru bergabung.
bands.accountability: Mutu dan ketepatan waktu pekerjaan rutinnya sendiri.

bands.title: Pita 3
bands.knowledge: Pengetahuan tentang berbagai prosedur, sebagian tidak rutin; biasanya kualifikasi tingkat 3 atau pengalaman yang setara.
bands.autonomy: Bekerja dalam prosedur; memutuskan cara mengatur pekerjaannya sendiri; meneruskan masalah ke atas.
bands.scope: Pekerjaannya sendiri dan sebagian tugas untuk tim yang lebih luas.
bands.leadership: Dapat membagi pekerjaan rutin atau melatih orang lain dalam prosedur.
bands.accountability: Ketelitian pekerjaannya sendiri dan catatan yang dipegangnya.

bands.title: Pita 4
bands.knowledge: Pengetahuan rinci tentang bidang kerja, biasanya dari diploma, magang, atau pengalaman yang setara.
bands.autonomy: Bekerja dalam pedoman; menyelesaikan sebagian besar masalah sehari-hari; atasan siap memberi saran.
bands.scope: Pekerjaannya sendiri dan sebuah layanan atau proses yang ditentukan.
bands.leadership: Dapat menyelia tim kecil atau mengoordinasikan pekerjaan orang lain.
bands.accountability: Penyampaian sebuah layanan atau proses yang ditentukan.

bands.title: Pita 5
bands.knowledge: Pengetahuan profesional atau teknis, biasanya dari gelar sarjana atau pengalaman yang setara.
bands.autonomy: Bekerja menuju sasaran yang luas dalam standar profesional; merencanakan pekerjaannya sendiri.
bands.scope: Pekerjaan profesionalnya sendiri dalam sebuah tim atau produk.
bands.leadership: Dapat membimbing dan memeriksa pekerjaan staf pendukung dan peserta magang.

bands.title: Pita 6
bands.knowledge: Pengetahuan spesialis di berbagai prosedur, dibangun melalui pelatihan lanjutan atau pengalaman.
bands.autonomy: Bekerja mandiri; menafsirkan kebijakan untuk bidangnya; meminta saran untuk masalah yang kompleks.
bands.scope: Sebuah produk, layanan, atau alur kerja.
bands.leadership: Dapat memimpin tim kecil atau membimbing rekan kerja.
bands.accountability: Hasil alur kerjanya sendiri dan mutu saran yang diberikan.

bands.title: Pita 7
bands.knowledge: Pengetahuan spesialis yang sangat berkembang, biasanya setingkat magister atau pengalaman yang setara.
bands.autonomy: Bekerja menurut kebijakan organisasi; memutuskan cara mencapai hasil; menjadi pakar tempat orang lain berkonsultasi.
bands.scope: Beberapa produk atau layanan, atau sebuah fungsi spesialis.
bands.leadership: Memimpin sebuah tim atau bidang praktik profesional.
bands.accountability: Penyampaian sebuah layanan atau fungsi spesialis, dan anggarannya jika dipegang.

bands.title: Pita 8a
bands.knowledge: Pengetahuan pakar tentang suatu disiplin dan pengelolaannya.
bands.autonomy: Menafsirkan kebijakan organisasi untuk sebuah layanan; menetapkan arah tim.
bands.scope: Sebuah bidang layanan atau suatu disiplin di seluruh organisasi.
bands.leadership: Mengelola sebuah tim, atau memimpin suatu disiplin tanpa manajemen garis.
bands.accountability: Sebuah bidang layanan, stafnya, dan anggarannya.

bands.title: Pita 8b
bands.knowledge: Pengetahuan pakar di beberapa disiplin atau sebuah layanan besar.
bands.autonomy: Membentuk kebijakan dan strategi untuk bidang yang luas.
bands.scope: Beberapa layanan atau tim, atau suatu disiplin tingkat utama.
bands.leadership: Mengelola para manajer, atau menjadi otoritas utama dalam suatu disiplin.

bands.title: Pita 8c
bands.knowledge: Pengetahuan pakar, serta pemahaman organisasi dan sektor yang luas.
bands.autonomy: Menetapkan strategi untuk sebuah fungsi; bertanggung jawab kepada seorang direktur.
bands.leadership: Memimpin sebuah fungsi melalui beberapa lapisan manajemen.
bands.accountability: Kinerja, tenaga kerja, dan anggaran sebuah fungsi.

bands.title: Pita 8d
bands.knowledge: Pengetahuan strategis lintas fungsi dan di sistem kesehatan dan perawatan yang lebih luas.
bands.autonomy: Membentuk strategi di seluruh organisasi; mewakili seorang direktur.
bands.scope: Sebuah fungsi utama atau beberapa fungsi.
bands.leadership: Memimpin beberapa fungsi atau sebuah departemen besar.
bands.accountability: Fungsi-fungsi utama, anggaran besar, dan risiko di seluruh organisasi.

bands.title: Pita 9
bands.knowledge: Keahlian strategis dan kepemimpinan di seluruh sistem.
bands.autonomy: Menetapkan strategi organisasi bersama tim eksekutif.
bands.scope: Organisasi, dan mitra-mitranya di seluruh sistem.
bands.accountability: Hasil, anggaran, dan risiko di seluruh organisasi.

factors.name: Keterampilan komunikasi dan hubungan
factors.description: Keterampilan yang diperlukan untuk berkomunikasi dengan, dan membangun hubungan dengan, rekan kerja, pasien, masyarakat, dan mitra. Mempertimbangkan seberapa kompleks, sensitif, atau kontroversial informasinya, dan hambatan apa pun terhadap pemahaman atau penerimaan.

levels.1: Memberi dan menerima informasi rutin secara lisan, terutama dengan rekan kerja.
levels.2: Memberi dan menerima informasi rutin secara lisan, tertulis, atau elektronik, dengan rekan kerja dan pihak lain.
levels.3: Memberi informasi rutin yang memerlukan kebijaksanaan atau bujukan, atau informasi yang kompleks atau sensitif, atau pelatihan sederhana kepada kelompok.
levels.4: Memberi informasi yang kompleks, sensitif, atau kontroversial yang memerlukan keterampilan membujuk, bernegosiasi, atau melatih, atau informasi yang sangat kompleks.
levels.5: Memberi informasi yang sangat kompleks atau kontroversial yang memerlukan keterampilan membujuk dan bernegosiasi yang berkembang, mempresentasikan kepada kelompok besar, atau berkomunikasi ketika ada hambatan besar terhadap penerimaan.
levels.6: Memberi informasi yang sangat kompleks dan sangat kontroversial ketika ada hambatan besar terhadap penerimaan, dengan keterampilan komunikasi tingkat tertinggi.

factors.name: Pengetahuan, pelatihan, dan pengalaman
factors.description: Pengetahuan dan pengalaman yang diperlukan untuk melakukan pekerjaan, dari sumber mana pun, termasuk pelatihan formal, kualifikasi, dan pengalaman.

levels.1: Beberapa prosedur rutin, dipelajari sambil bekerja dalam orientasi singkat.
levels.2: Berbagai prosedur rutin, dipelajari melalui pelatihan sambil bekerja dan orientasi.
levels.3: Berbagai prosedur, sebagian tidak rutin, yang memerlukan teori tingkat dasar (misalnya kualifikasi tingkat 3 atau pengalaman yang setara).
levels.4: Berbagai prosedur, sebagian besar tidak rutin, yang memerlukan teori tingkat menengah (misalnya diploma atau pengalaman yang setara).
levels.5: Keahlian dalam suatu spesialisasi, didukung oleh teori atau pengalaman praktis (setingkat sarjana atau yang setara).
levels.6: Pengetahuan spesialis di seluruh cakupan spesialisasi (setingkat diploma pascasarjana atau yang setara).
levels.7: Pengetahuan spesialis yang sangat berkembang di seluruh cakupan spesialisasi (setingkat magister atau yang setara).
levels.8: Pengetahuan tingkat lanjut (doktor ditambah pelatihan lanjutan atau yang setara), atau pengetahuan spesialis di lebih dari satu disiplin yang dibangun dalam waktu lama.

factors.name: Keterampilan analisis dan pertimbangan
factors.description: Analisis dan pertimbangan yang diperlukan untuk mengolah informasi, memecahkan masalah, dan mengambil keputusan.

levels.1: Pertimbangan atas fakta atau situasi yang sederhana.
levels.2: Pertimbangan atas fakta atau situasi, sebagian memerlukan analisis.
levels.3: Pertimbangan atas berbagai fakta atau situasi yang memerlukan analisis atau perbandingan pilihan.
levels.4: Pertimbangan atas fakta atau situasi yang kompleks yang memerlukan analisis, penafsiran, dan perbandingan pilihan.
levels.5: Pertimbangan atas fakta atau situasi yang sangat kompleks yang memerlukan analisis, penafsiran, dan perbandingan pilihan.

factors.name: Keterampilan perencanaan dan pengorganisasian
factors.description: Perencanaan dan pengorganisasian yang diperlukan untuk menjalankan kegiatan, program, layanan, atau strategi.

levels.2: Merencanakan tugas atau kegiatan yang sederhana, sebagian berkelanjutan.
levels.3: Merencanakan beberapa kegiatan yang kompleks, menyesuaikan rencana sesuai kebutuhan.
levels.4: Merencanakan beragam kegiatan atau strategi yang kompleks, menyesuaikannya sesuai kebutuhan.
levels.5: Menyusun rencana strategis jangka panjang, dengan ketidakpastian dan dampak di seluruh organisasi.

factors.name: Keterampilan fisik
factors.description: Keterampilan fisik yang diperlukan, seperti ketangkasan, koordinasi, keterampilan papan ketik, dan mengemudi.

levels.2: Keterampilan yang diperoleh melalui latihan, seperti penggunaan papan ketik standar atau mengemudi.
levels.3: Keterampilan yang berkembang yang memerlukan kecepatan atau ketelitian, seperti penggunaan papan ketik tingkat lanjut.
levels.4: Keterampilan yang sangat berkembang yang memerlukan ketepatan atau kecepatan dan koordinasi tangan dan mata yang tinggi.
levels.5: Tingkat ketepatan, kecepatan, dan koordinasi tertinggi.

factors.name: Tanggung jawab atas perawatan pasien dan klien
factors.description: Tanggung jawab untuk menilai, mengobati, merawat, atau menasihati pasien dan klien. Untuk sebagian besar peran digital dan korporat, ini hanya kontak sesekali.

levels.1: Membantu pasien, klien, atau kerabat dalam kontak sesekali.
levels.2: Memberi saran, informasi, atau layanan umum nonklinis secara langsung kepada pasien atau masyarakat.
levels.3: Memberi perawatan pribadi, layanan teknis klinis dasar, atau saran klinis dasar.
levels.4: Melakukan perawatan klinis, memberi layanan teknis klinis, atau menasihati tentang perawatan pasien.
levels.5: Menyusun program perawatan, memberi layanan teknis klinis spesialis, atau memberi saran khusus tentang perawatan pasien.
levels.6: Mengembangkan perawatan khusus, memberi saran yang sangat khusus, atau bertanggung jawab atas sebagian layanan klinis.
levels.7: Bertanggung jawab atas penyampaian layanan klinis atau perawatan.
levels.8: Tanggung jawab korporat atas layanan klinis atau perawatan.

factors.name: Tanggung jawab atas pengembangan kebijakan dan layanan
factors.description: Tanggung jawab untuk mengembangkan dan menerapkan kebijakan dan layanan, serta sejauh mana dampaknya.

levels.1: Mengikuti kebijakan yang ditetapkan orang lain; dapat mengomentari perubahan.
levels.2: Menerapkan kebijakan untuk bidangnya sendiri dan mengusulkan perubahan pada praktiknya.
levels.3: Menerapkan kebijakan untuk bidangnya sendiri dan mengusulkan perubahan yang memengaruhi bidang lain.
levels.4: Menerapkan kebijakan dan mengembangkan kebijakan atau layanan untuk sebuah layanan atau beberapa bidang.
levels.5: Menerapkan dan mengembangkan berbagai kebijakan atau layanan untuk sebuah direktorat.
levels.6: Tanggung jawab korporat atas pengembangan kebijakan atau layanan besar di dalam atau di luar organisasi.

factors.name: Tanggung jawab atas sumber daya keuangan dan fisik
factors.description: Tanggung jawab atas uang, anggaran, peralatan, persediaan, bangunan, dan aset lainnya.

levels.1: Menjaga sendiri peralatan dan sumber daya yang dipakai dalam pekerjaannya.
levels.2: Menangani uang tunai atau barang berharga, menjaga peralatan yang dipakai orang lain, mengendalikan persediaan, atau mengesahkan pembayaran kecil.
levels.3: Mengesahkan pembayaran, membeli sebagian aset atau perlengkapan, memantau atau memegang anggaran yang didelegasikan, atau memelihara aset.
levels.4: Memegang atau menetapkan anggaran untuk sebuah departemen atau layanan, atau membeli atau memelihara asetnya.
levels.5: Memegang atau menetapkan anggaran, atau mengelola aset, untuk beberapa layanan.
levels.6: Tanggung jawab korporat atas keuangan atau aset organisasi.

factors.name: Tanggung jawab atas orang
factors.description: Tanggung jawab untuk mengelola, menyelia, melatih, atau mengembangkan staf, atau untuk menyediakan layanan sumber daya manusia (SDM).

levels.1: Menunjukkan rutinitas kerjanya kepada rekan kerja yang baru atau kurang berpengalaman.
levels.2: Menyelia atau mengoordinasikan staf sehari-hari, melatih orang lain secara teratur, atau memberi saran SDM dasar.
levels.3: Mengelola sekelompok staf sehari-hari, mengajar pelatihan inti atau spesialis, atau memberi saran SDM inti.
levels.4: Mengelola secara langsung sebuah fungsi atau departemen, merancang program pelatihan sebagai tugas utama, atau menyampaikan rangkaian layanan SDM yang lengkap.
levels.5: Mengelola secara langsung beberapa departemen, atau mengelola pelatihan atau sebagian besar SDM di seluruh organisasi.
levels.6: Tanggung jawab korporat atas orang atau fungsi SDM organisasi.

factors.name: Tanggung jawab atas sumber daya informasi
factors.description: Tanggung jawab atas informasi dan sistem informasi, kertas atau digital, termasuk catatan, data, dan sistem yang menyimpannya.

levels.1: Mencatat informasi yang dihasilkan oleh pemegang jabatan.
levels.2: Memasukkan atau menyimpan data yang dikumpulkan orang lain, atau sesekali menulis laporan atau kueri.
levels.3: Membuat notulen resmi, rutin menulis laporan atau kueri, atau memelihara sistem informasi sebagai tugas penting.
levels.4: Menyesuaikan atau merancang sistem informasi sesuai spesifikasi orang lain, atau menjalankan sistem informasi sebuah departemen sebagai tugas utama.
levels.5: Merancang dan mengembangkan sistem informasi besar, atau menjalankan sistem informasi beberapa layanan sebagai tugas utama.
levels.6: Mengelola dan mengembangkan sistem informasi di seluruh organisasi sebagai tugas utama.
levels.7: Tanggung jawab korporat atas sistem informasi organisasi.

factors.name: Tanggung jawab atas penelitian dan pengembangan
factors.description: Tanggung jawab atas penelitian formal, pengembangan, evaluasi, audit, pengujian, dan uji coba.

levels.1: Melakukan survei atau audit untuk pekerjaannya sendiri; sesekali ikut serta dalam penelitian atau pengujian.
levels.2: Secara teratur melakukan penelitian, pengembangan, uji coba, atau pengujian peralatan dan sistem sebagai bagian dari pekerjaan.
levels.3: Melakukan penelitian atau pengembangan dalam program formal sebagai tugas utama.
levels.4: Mengoordinasikan dan melaksanakan program penelitian dan pengembangan.
levels.5: Memprakarsai dan mengembangkan program penelitian dan pengembangan yang mendukung tujuan organisasi.
levels.6: Memprakarsai dan mengembangkan program penelitian dan pengembangan dengan dampak di luar organisasi.

factors.name: Kebebasan bertindak
factors.description: Sejauh mana pemegang jabatan memutuskan apa yang dilakukan dan bagaimana, dan seberapa ketat pekerjaannya diselia.

levels.1: Bekerja dalam prosedur yang ditetapkan, dengan penyelia di dekatnya.
levels.2: Mengikuti prosedur standar dan preseden; biasanya ada orang yang dapat ditanya; pekerjaan dapat diperiksa.
levels.3: Mengikuti kebijakan dan prosedur yang ditentukan; pekerjaan dikelola dan bukan diselia.
levels.4: Hasilnya ditentukan, tetapi pemegang jabatan memutuskan cara mencapainya, dalam kebijakan yang luas.
levels.5: Bekerja dalam kebijakan umum, dan dalam sebagian besar kasus memutuskan cara menafsirkannya.
levels.6: Menafsirkan kebijakan dan strategi menyeluruh untuk menetapkan sasaran dan standar.

factors.name: Upaya fisik
factors.description: Upaya fisik yang diperlukan, dengan mempertimbangkan frekuensi, durasi, dan intensitasnya.

levels.1: Duduk, berdiri, dan berjalan, dengan sedikit upaya fisik.
levels.2: Sering duduk atau berdiri dalam posisi terbatas, atau sesekali upaya ringan hingga sedang.
levels.3: Sering melakukan upaya ringan dalam waktu lama, atau sering melakukan upaya sedang dalam waktu singkat.
levels.4: Upaya ringan yang terus-menerus, upaya sedang yang sering dalam waktu lama, atau sesekali upaya yang intens.
levels.5: Upaya sedang yang terus-menerus, atau upaya intens yang sering.

factors.name: Upaya mental
factors.description: Konsentrasi yang diperlukan, dengan mempertimbangkan frekuensi, durasi, dan seberapa dapat diprediksi pekerjaannya.

levels.1: Perhatian umum; sesekali berkonsentrasi pada pekerjaan yang dapat diprediksi.
levels.2: Sering berkonsentrasi pada pekerjaan yang dapat diprediksi, atau sesekali berkonsentrasi pada pekerjaan yang tidak dapat diprediksi.
levels.3: Sering berkonsentrasi pada pekerjaan yang tidak dapat diprediksi, atau sesekali berkonsentrasi dalam waktu lama.
levels.4: Sering berkonsentrasi dalam waktu lama, atau sesekali berkonsentrasi secara intens.

factors.name: Upaya emosional
factors.description: Tuntutan emosional pekerjaan, dari paparan langsung atau tidak langsung pada keadaan yang menekan, seperti membaca catatan kasus yang menyedihkan atau menangani insiden serius.

levels.1: Jarang terpapar, atau sesekali terpapar secara tidak langsung, pada keadaan yang menekan.
levels.2: Sesekali terpapar, atau sering terpapar secara tidak langsung, pada keadaan yang menekan.
levels.3: Sering terpapar pada keadaan yang menekan, atau sesekali terpapar pada keadaan yang sangat menekan.
levels.4: Sesekali terpapar pada keadaan traumatis, atau sering terpapar pada keadaan yang sangat menekan.

factors.name: Kondisi kerja
factors.description: Paparan pada kondisi yang tidak menyenangkan atau bahaya. Penggunaan layar hampir terus-menerus pada sebagian besar hari dihitung sebagai tingkat 2.

levels.1: Jarang terpapar pada kondisi yang tidak menyenangkan.
levels.2: Sesekali mengalami kondisi yang tidak menyenangkan, sering bepergian atau bekerja di luar ruangan, atau menggunakan layar hampir terus-menerus pada sebagian besar hari.
levels.3: Sering mengalami kondisi yang tidak menyenangkan, atau sesekali mengalami kondisi yang sangat tidak menyenangkan.
levels.4: Terpapar bahaya sampai batas tertentu, atau sering mengalami kondisi yang sangat tidak menyenangkan.

skills.name: Accessibility
skills.description: Accessibility involves ensuring your service can be used by as many people as possible, including those with impaired vision, motor difficulties, cognitive impairments, learning disabilities and deafness.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- understand accessibility and that users have different accessibility needs
- help fix accessibility issues under the direction of others
levels.working:
You can:
- understand users have different accessibility needs
- build user interfaces that meet accessibility standards and fix accessibility issues under the direction of others
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- build user interfaces that meet a predefined set of standards
- champion accessibility to internal stakeholders
- offer design feedback to mitigate the risk of failing accessibility testing
- offer recommendations on the best tools and methods to use when accessibility testing
levels.expert:
You can:
- show a strong understanding of accessibility and be an advocate for users with accessibility needs
- build user interfaces that meet a predefined set of standards
- champion accessibility to internal and external stakeholders
- offer design solutions to mitigate the risk of failing accessibility testing
- recommend the best tools and methods to use when accessibility testing

esco.label: test system accessibility for users with special needs

skills.name: Adapting to delivery methodologies
skills.description: Adapting to delivery methodologies involves contributing to discussions on the appropriate delivery methodology to use, and adapting your approach based on the delivery methodology of the team.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain the differences between delivery methodologies, such as scrum or kanban
- explain how your approach would change based on the delivery methodology
- explain why iteration is important
- explain how roles in a multidisciplinary team work together to support delivery
levels.working:
You can:
- explain how products and services are delivered through different methodologies
- follow an appropriate approach to complete your work within the delivery methodology used by your team
- adapt how you work and the work you produce based on your team's delivery methodology to ensure you deliver value
- adapt how you work with other roles in a multidisciplinary team in line with the delivery methodology
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- determine the approach for your role within the team's delivery methodology
- define and agree the scope of delivery for your role within a multidisciplinary team
- negotiate and agree delivery priorities with the team and relevant stakeholders
- clearly communicate the value of iterative delivery and realising benefits early
levels.expert:
You can:
- set and iterate standards for working within different delivery methodologies
- actively promote collaboration and agreement to ensure the team delivers value at the right time
- experiment with new and innovative ways of working to enhance delivery outcomes
- research new and evolving delivery methodologies and identify how your role would work within them

skills.name: Agile and Lean practices
skills.description: Agile and Lean practices involves encouraging teams to build incrementally, test and iterate their work based on regular feedback and other useful data.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain the basic principles of Agile and Lean methodology
- discuss ways to apply Agile and Lean principles in a multi-disciplinary team
- explain why iteration is important
levels.working:
You can:
- demonstrate experience in applying Agile principles in practice
- provide a clear, open and transparent framework in which teams can deliver
- show an awareness of Agile tools and are starting to use them intelligently
- visualise and make visible the work of the team
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- compare and select the most appropriate delivery methods and processes
- recognise, reflect and adapt when something does not work, encouraging experimentation
- use a blended approach depending on the context
- help teams to measure, evaluate and visualise outcomes
- encourage reflective practice to improve ways of working
levels.expert:
You can:
- coach and lead teams in Agile and Lean good practices
- create and tailor the right approach for a team, challenging, evaluating and iterating the approach through the life cycle
- experiment with new and innovative ways of working to improve delivery across the organisation
- act as a recognised expert and advocate for Agile and Lean approaches

skills.name: Agile research practices
skills.description: Agile delivery involves encouraging teams to build incrementally, test and iterate their work based on regular feedback and other useful data.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- describe agile working and the roles in a multidisciplinary digital team
levels.working:
You can:
- understand and explain the benefits and limitations of agile working
- design and conduct your research so the findings can be embedded into an agile workflow
- understand and work with the different roles in a multidisciplinary digital team to plan and do user research
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- advocate for agile working
- adapt how you design and conduct research to respond to the complexity of the product environment
- understand the strategic decisions the team needs to make so you can design appropriate research
- influence decisions about priorities and agile processes in the team
levels.expert:
You can:
- advocate for agile working at the organisational level and with senior stakeholders
- help organisations adopt agile research practices
- set standards and expectations of how research insights should be delivered to support delivery by agile teams

levels.expert:

levels.expert:

skills.name: Kesetaraan, keberagaman, dan inklusi

skills.name: Penelitian etis dengan pasien dan tenaga perawatan
skills.description: Merencanakan dan menjalankan penelitian dengan pasien, pendamping, tenaga klinis, dan tenaga perawatan secara aman dan etis, termasuk persetujuan berdasarkan informasi, perlindungan, penelitian dengan orang dalam keadaan rentan, dan mengetahui kapan persetujuan etik formal diperlukan.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:

levels.working:

- mengenali dan melaporkan kekhawatiran perlindungan yang muncul dalam penelitian
levels.practitioner:

levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- menetapkan standar organisasi untuk penelitian etis dengan pasien, pendamping, dan tenaga perawatan
- menjamin praktik penelitian lintas tim dan menasihati tentang penelitian berisiko tinggi
- mewakili praktik penelitian di hadapan badan etik, perlindungan, dan tata kelola

skills.description: Evidence-based design involves defining hypotheses and using qualitative evidence (such as insights from user research) and quantitative evidence (such as web analytics and management information) to inform design decisions.

levels.expert:

skills.description: Menjaga diri sendiri dan orang lain tetap aman dan sehat di tempat kerja, termasuk penilaian risiko, praktik kerja yang aman, dan pelaporan insiden.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- mengikuti aturan kesehatan dan keselamatan serta melaporkan bahaya dan insiden
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- melakukan penilaian risiko sederhana, seperti penilaian tempat kerja
- membantu rekan kerja bekerja dengan aman
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- mengelola kesehatan dan keselamatan untuk sebuah tim atau lokasi
- menyelidiki insiden dan menerapkan pengendalian
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- menetapkan kebijakan kesehatan, keselamatan, dan kesejahteraan untuk organisasi
- melaporkan kinerja keselamatan kepada dewan

esco.label: health and safety in the workplace

skills.name: Administrasi SDM
skills.description: Menjalankan proses administrasi siklus ketenagakerjaan secara akurat dan rahasia, dari kontrak dan staf baru hingga perubahan, catatan ketidakhadiran, dan staf yang keluar.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- mengikuti prosedur organisasi untuk staf baru, perubahan, dan staf yang keluar
- menjaga kerahasiaan dan kemutakhiran catatan pribadi
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- menyiapkan kontrak, surat perubahan, dan pemeriksaan ketenagakerjaan secara akurat
- memproses perubahan dalam sistem SDM dan penggajian sesuai tenggat
- menjawab pertanyaan rutin dari manajer dan staf tentang proses SDM
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- menjalankan layanan administrasi SDM, memeriksa mutu, dan memenuhi standar layanan
- memperbaiki proses dan templat, dan mengotomatiskan langkah rutin jika bisa
- menyelesaikan kasus yang kompleks atau tidak biasa, seperti kelebihan pembayaran atau kesalahan kontrak
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- merancang model operasi SDM dan standar layanan organisasi
- memimpin peralihan ke proses SDM digital dan layanan mandiri
- menetapkan pengendalian yang menjaga data SDM dan penggajian tetap akurat dan sah

skills.name: Faktor manusia dan kegunaan dalam sistem klinis
skills.description: Menerapkan metode faktor manusia dan kegunaan pada sistem klinis, agar tenaga klinis, tenaga perawatan, dan pasien dapat menggunakannya dengan aman dan dengan sesedikit mungkin kesalahan.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- menjelaskan bagaimana desain yang buruk dapat menyebabkan kesalahan dalam perawatan
- melaporkan masalah kegunaan yang dapat memengaruhi keselamatan pasien
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- ikut serta dalam uji kegunaan dan simulasi tugas klinis
- mengenali bahaya desain yang umum, seperti pilihan yang tampak mirip atau peringatan yang tersembunyi
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- merencanakan dan menjalankan penilaian faktor manusia atas sistem klinis
- mengubah temuan menjadi perubahan desain dan pengendalian keselamatan klinis
- menilai beban peringatan dan risiko jalan pintas
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- menetapkan pendekatan organisasi terhadap faktor manusia dalam layanan digital
- meninjau bukti faktor manusia untuk sistem dan perubahan berisiko tinggi
- membangun keterampilan faktor manusia di tim klinis dan digital

skills.name: Manajemen identitas dan akses
skills.description: Mengelola identitas digital, autentikasi, dan hak akses untuk staf, pasien, dan sistem, termasuk akses berbasis peran dan autentikasi kartu pintar atau multifaktor.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- mengikuti aturan akses dan melindungi kredensial Anda
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- membuat, mengubah, dan menghapus akun pengguna dan hak akses
- memeriksa akses terhadap aturan akses berbasis peran
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- merancang dan menjalankan layanan identitas dan akses
- meninjau akses secara teratur dan memperbaiki masalah
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- menetapkan strategi identitas dan akses untuk staf, pasien, dan sistem
- memimpin penerapan standar identitas baru

skills.name: Incident management
skills.description: Incident management involves coordinating the response to incident reports, ensuring effective prioritisation, investigation and resolution.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- identify and register incidents, gathering the required information and allocating it to the appropriate channel
levels.working:
You can:
- diagnose and prioritise incidents, investigate their causes and find resolutions
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- lead the investigation and resolution of incidents
levels.expert: This skill level is currently not defined.

skills.name: Inclusive research
skills.description: Inclusion involves including everyone to incorporate disparate views and requirements, whether developing products and services or internal policies.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- demonstrate some awareness of the diversity of users of government services and the need to make government services usable and accessible for everyone
levels.working:
You can:
- understand the diversity of users of government services and the need to make services usable and accessible for everyone
- work with colleagues to include many kinds of users in appropriate research activities
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- help teams understand the diversity of users of government services
- effectively include all kinds of users in appropriate research activities
- advocate inclusive practices and help teams design and deliver accessible services that work for all users
levels.expert:
You can:
- help organisations understand the diversity of users of government services
- guide organisations to adopt inclusive practices and apply what they learn to design and deliver accessible services that work for all users

skills.name: Hukum informasi dan data
skills.description: Menerapkan hukum pelindungan data, kerahasiaan, keterbukaan informasi, dan keamanan siber pada data kesehatan dan perawatan serta layanan digital.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- menjelaskan prinsip dasar pelindungan data dan kerahasiaan
- mengenali permintaan informasi dan pelanggaran data serta meneruskannya dengan benar
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- meninjau perjanjian pembagian data dan pemrosesan data terhadap templat
- mendukung tanggapan atas permintaan informasi dan permintaan hak subjek data
- menjelaskan dasar hukum penggunaan data kesehatan dalam situasi umum
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- menasihati tentang pelindungan data, kewajiban kerahasiaan, dan hukum akses informasi untuk layanan digital
- menyusun dan menegosiasikan perjanjian pembagian data dan ketentuan pemrosesan data, termasuk transfer internasional
- menasihati tentang penilaian dampak pelindungan data untuk teknologi baru, seperti AI dan platform analitik
- menasihati tentang pelanggaran data, pertanyaan regulator, dan keluhan
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- menetapkan posisi hukum organisasi atas penggunaan data kesehatan dan perawatan
- memimpin penggunaan data yang berisiko tinggi atau baru, seperti penelitian, platform data, dan AI
- mewakili organisasi di hadapan regulator dalam hukum informasi

skills.name: Tata kelola informasi dan pelindungan data
skills.description: Menangani informasi pribadi dan kesehatan secara sah, aman, dan etis, termasuk hukum pelindungan data, kerahasiaan, persetujuan, penilaian dampak pelindungan data, dan pembagian informasi.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- mengikuti aturan organisasi untuk menangani informasi pribadi dan kesehatan
- mengenali dan melaporkan pelanggaran data atau nyaris celaka
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- menerapkan prinsip pelindungan data pada pekerjaan Anda
- menyumbang pada penilaian dampak pelindungan data
- menangani permintaan informasi dan arsip dengan benar
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- memimpin penilaian dampak pelindungan data dan perjanjian pembagian informasi
- menasihati tim tentang dasar hukum, persetujuan, kerahasiaan, dan retensi
- menyelidiki insiden dan merekomendasikan perbaikan
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- menetapkan kebijakan dan strategi tata kelola informasi
- menasihati dewan tentang risiko dan kepatuhan informasi
- mewakili organisasi di hadapan regulator dan mitra

skills.name: Penjaminan dan audit tata kelola informasi
skills.description: Memeriksa dan menunjukkan bahwa organisasi memenuhi standar tata kelola informasi, melalui penilaian mandiri tahunan, audit, bukti, dan rencana perbaikan.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- menjelaskan mengapa organisasi harus menunjukkan bahwa ia menangani informasi dengan baik
- menyediakan bukti untuk audit ketika diminta
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- mengumpulkan dan menata bukti untuk penilaian mandiri tahunan
- melakukan audit sederhana, seperti audit akses atau pencatatan arsip
- melacak tindakan perbaikan
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- merencanakan dan menjalankan program penjaminan tata kelola informasi
- menilai apakah bukti memenuhi standar dan mengidentifikasi kesenjangan
- bekerja dengan auditor internal dan eksternal
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- memiliki kerangka penjaminan tata kelola informasi organisasi
- melaporkan penjaminan dan kepatuhan kepada dewan dan komitenya
- menetapkan prioritas perbaikan berdasarkan risiko

esco.label: participate in medical records' auditing activities

skills.name: Manajemen insiden tata kelola informasi
skills.description: Mencatat, menyelidiki, dan belajar dari pelanggaran data dan nyaris celaka, serta memutuskan kapan memberi tahu regulator dan orang yang terdampak.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- mengenali pelanggaran data atau nyaris celaka dan segera melaporkannya
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- mencatat insiden dan mengumpulkan fakta
- menilai insiden berdasarkan kriteria keparahan organisasi
- melacak tindakan sampai selesai
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- menyelidiki insiden serius dan menemukan akar penyebabnya
- memutuskan, bersama rekan senior, apakah akan memberi tahu regulator dan orang yang terdampak
- membagikan pelajaran dan melacak perbaikan
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- menetapkan proses manajemen insiden untuk tata kelola informasi
- memimpin tanggapan atas pelanggaran besar, termasuk dengan regulator dan media
- melaporkan tren dan risiko insiden kepada dewan

esco.label: provide advice on breaches of regulation

skills.name: Permintaan hak atas informasi
skills.description: Menangani permintaan dari individu dan masyarakat untuk mengakses informasi, seperti permintaan mengakses rekam kesehatan pribadi dan permintaan informasi yang dimiliki organisasi, dalam batas waktu hukum.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- mengenali permintaan hak atas informasi dan segera meneruskannya
- menjelaskan bahwa permintaan memiliki batas waktu hukum
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- mencatat, mengonfirmasi, dan melacak permintaan agar memenuhi batas waktu
- mengumpulkan dan menyamarkan informasi, serta menyusun draf tanggapan untuk ditinjau
- memeriksa identitas dan kewenangan orang yang meminta
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- menangani permintaan yang kompleks atau sensitif, termasuk yang melibatkan pihak ketiga
- menerapkan pengecualian dan memutuskan apa yang ditahan, dengan alasan yang jelas
- mengelola tinjauan internal dan keluhan atas tanggapan
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- menetapkan kebijakan dan proses hak atas informasi di seluruh organisasi
- memimpin tanggapan atas pertanyaan dan banding dari regulator
- melaporkan kinerja dan tren kepada pimpinan senior

skills.name: Information security
skills.description: Information security involves maintaining the security, confidentiality and integrity of information.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain information security and the security controls available to protect solutions and services
levels.working:
You can:
- use information security practices and available security controls to contribute to protecting solutions and services
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- design solutions and services with security controls included, specifically engineered to mitigate security threats
levels.expert:
You can:
- design, review and quality assure solutions and services, ensuring that they are specifically engineered to mitigate security threats
- lead others in using appropriate information security practices

skills.name: Kekayaan intelektual
skills.description: Melindungi dan menggunakan kekayaan intelektual dalam perangkat lunak, data, konten, dan penemuan, termasuk hak cipta, lisensi, sumber terbuka, dan merek dagang.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- menjelaskan bahwa perangkat lunak, data, dan konten dilindungi oleh hak kekayaan intelektual
- mengenali kapan sebuah kontrak atau proyek memunculkan pertanyaan kepemilikan
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- memeriksa klausul kekayaan intelektual dalam perjanjian rutin
- menyimpan catatan lisensi dan hak terdaftar
- menjelaskan jenis utama lisensi sumber terbuka dan ketentuannya
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- menasihati tentang siapa yang memiliki perangkat lunak, data, dan konten yang dibuat oleh staf, pemasok, dan mitra
- menyusun lisensi dan ketentuan kekayaan intelektual, termasuk perilisan kode organisasi sebagai sumber terbuka
- menasihati tentang pemanfaatan komersial data dan perangkat lunak organisasi, dan tentang pembagian manfaat
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- menetapkan kebijakan kekayaan intelektual dan sumber terbuka organisasi
- memimpin komersialisasi dan kemitraan yang melibatkan data dan perangkat lunak organisasi
- menyelesaikan sengketa kekayaan intelektual yang signifikan

skills.name: Komunikasi internal
skills.description: Menjaga staf tetap terinformasi dan terlibat melalui kanal seperti intranet, buletin, pengarahan, dan acara, terutama selama perubahan.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- menerbitkan konten di kanal internal seperti intranet
- mengikuti gaya dan nada suara organisasi
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- menulis dan menyunting berita, pengarahan, dan buletin untuk staf
- merencanakan konten untuk kanal internal dan mengukur keterlibatan
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- merencanakan komunikasi internal untuk perubahan besar, seperti sistem klinis baru
- menasihati pemimpin tentang cara melibatkan staf dan menyampaikan pesan yang sulit
- menggunakan umpan balik dan data untuk memperbaiki kanal
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- menetapkan strategi komunikasi internal dan keterlibatan staf
- menasihati tim eksekutif tentang budaya dan keterlibatan

skills.name: IT infrastructure
skills.description: IT infrastructure involves ensuring systems and processes are available, adaptable, reliable and secure.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- support infrastructure solutions and services, and other computer, storage, networking, physical infrastructure, software, commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) software and open source packages and solutions
- support virtual and cloud computing, including Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS) and Software as a Service (SaaS)
levels.working:
You can:
- build, configure, administer and support infrastructure solutions and services, for example, networking and physical infrastructure, commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) software, open source packages and solutions, or virtual and cloud computing
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- design and implement infrastructure solutions and services, for example, networking and physical infrastructure, commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) software, open source packages and solutions, or virtual and cloud computing
levels.expert:
You can:
- lead teams and departments in the design, implementation, administration and support of infrastructure solutions and services

skills.name: IT service reporting
skills.description: IT service reporting involves analysing data to understand how an IT product or service has performed against the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

levels.awareness:
You can:
- collate data from data repositories and provide basic reporting
- explain what a Key Performance Indicator (KPI) is and why it is important
levels.working:
You can:
- produce relevant reports in an appropriate format and agreed timeframe
- work with stakeholders to discuss any changes in the reporting processes
- interpret a data set and communicate this to others
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- use data analytics skills to make decisions that enhance business performance
levels.expert:
You can:
- use prediction methodologies to produce and maintain a holistic view of important trends across multiple processes.

skills.name: Iterative design
skills.description: Iterative design involves continuously testing hypotheses, using techniques such as creating prototypes (for example sketching journey flows, drafting content, mocking up screens, or building realistic journeys in code).

levels.awareness:
You can:
- describe the basics of iterative ways of working used in design, such as agile
- explain how iteration supports user-centred design
- describe ways to test design ideas at different levels of detail and realism, and when to use them
levels.working:
You can:
- apply iterative design principles and techniques and agile methodologies to your work
- create material to test ideas and hypotheses at an appropriate fidelity, for example mockups or drafts
- iterate and improve a design based on successive rounds of research
- use and iterate design patterns and components
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- help other designers apply iterative design principles and agile methodologies to their work and create materials to test their ideas
- adapt designs effectively to changes in requirements, priorities or user needs
- help your team to define a minimum viable product (MVP) and determine what to prioritise for iteration
levels.expert:
You can:
- embed the practice of iterative design and agile working in teams or wider organisation
- guide designers in creating materials to test complex ideas at any fidelity
- help teams adapt quickly to changes in requirements, priorities or user needs
- iterate delivery processes or team structures to help teams work effectively

esco.label: create prototype of user experience solutions

skills.name: Leadership and guidance
skills.description: Leadership and guidance involves providing effective leadership and management through team motivation, decision making, risk management, mediation and professional development

levels.awareness:
You can:
- show commitment to agreed good practice for the team, teaching new starters and challenging substandard work by peers
- recommend decisions and describe the reasoning behind them
- identify and articulate technical disputes between direct peers and local stakeholders
- show an understanding of the importance of team dynamics, collaboration and feedback
levels.working:
You can:
- contribute to best practice guidelines
- understand the sustainability and consequences of your decisions and can make decisions characterised by managed levels of risk and complexity
- resolve technical disputes between wider peers and indirect stakeholders, taking into account all views and opinions
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- make decisions characterised by medium levels of risk and complexity and recommend decisions as risk and complexity increase
- build consensus between services or independent stakeholders
- identify problems or issues in the team dynamic and rectify them
- engage in varying types of feedback, choosing the right type at the appropriate time and ensuring the discussion and decision stick
- bring people together to form a motivated team and help create the right environment for a team to work in
- facilitate the best team makeup depending on the situation
levels.expert:
You can:
- change organisational structures to fixable and sustainable designs
- lead on the strategy for the whole organisation, marrying business needs with innovative analysis
- make and justify decisions characterised by high levels of risk, impact and complexity
- build consensus between organisations (private or public) or highly independent and diverse stakeholders
- solve and unblock issues between teams or departments at the highest level
- understand the psychology of a team and have strong mediation skills
- coach the organisation on team dynamics and conflict resolution

skills.name: Leadership and guidance (frontend developer)
skills.description: Leadership and guidance involves providing effective leadership and management through team motivation, decision making, risk management, mediation and professional development

levels.awareness:
You can:
- follow agreed good practice for the team
- show an awareness of the importance of team dynamics and collaboration
- understand the importance of feedback
levels.working:
You can:
- understand the impact of decisions
- make decisions characterised by different levels of risk and complexity
- resolve technical disputes between wider peers and indirect stakeholders, taking into account all views and opinions
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- make decisions characterised by medium levels of risk and complexity, and can recommend decisions as risk and complexity increase
- contribute to best practice guidelines
levels.expert:
You can:
- change organisational structures to fixable and sustainable designs
- lead on the strategy for the whole organisation, marrying business needs with innovative analysis
- make and justify decisions characterised by high levels of risk, impact and complexity
- build consensus between organisations (private or public) or highly independent stakeholders
- solve and unblock issues between teams or departments at the highest level
- understand the psychology of a team and have strong mediation skills
- coach the organisation on team dynamics and conflict resolution

skills.name: Leading design
skills.description: Leading design involves supporting designers, coordinating design work and improving design maturity in your organisation.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain the role of user-centred design in an organisation
- describe typical leadership responsibilities in design
- identify leaders in your organisation that designers need to work with
levels.working:
You can:
- lead and coordinate design work in your team, with support
- communicate the value of user-centred design to your team or others in your organisation
- support other designers
- work with digital and data leaders in your organisation, when needed
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- lead and coordinate design work for a team
- advocate for user-centred design with leaders outside of digital and data
- create an inclusive, productive environment for designers to work in
- mentor and coach other designers
- iterate and improve design processes within your team
levels.expert:
You can:
- set a vision for and lead design across multiple teams or a whole organisation
- work effectively with senior leaders across your organisation or wider public sector
- support a culture of learning and experimentation in your organisation
- iterate and measurably improve design maturity within your organisation and its partners

skills.name: Leading performance and benefits
skills.description: Leading performance and benefits involves using appropriate measures, metrics, data and insights to ensure the delivery of valuable outcomes and business benefits.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain why it's important to manage performance and benefits
- describe data and metrics that are valuable in informing day-to-day service actions and decisions
levels.working:
You can:
- contribute to putting measures in place to deliver valuable outcomes to users and traceable business benefits
- use data and metrics to inform day-to-day service actions and decisions
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- put measures in place to ensure the delivery of valuable outcomes to users and traceable business benefits
- use data and metrics to actively monitor, manage and prioritise service delivery and inform decision making
- identify and share appropriate data and insights with specific stakeholders
levels.expert:
You can:
- ensure appropriate measures are in place to deliver valuable outcomes to users and agreed business benefits
- ensure metrics are used to monitor, manage and prioritise delivery and inform decision making
- demonstrate the value of the service and build understanding with stakeholders by ensuring effective data and insights are shared

skills.name: Perancangan dan penyampaian pembelajaran
skills.description: Menganalisis kebutuhan belajar, lalu merancang, menyampaikan, dan mengevaluasi pembelajaran secara tatap muka, daring, dan dalam alur kerja.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- menjelaskan perbedaan antara pelatihan, pembelajaran, dan pengembangan
- mendukung penyelenggaraan kursus dan menyimpan catatan pelatihan
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- menyampaikan sesi pelatihan yang terdefinisi dengan baik secara tatap muka dan daring
- membangun e-learning sederhana dalam sistem manajemen pembelajaran
- mengumpulkan dan merangkum umpan balik peserta
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- menganalisis kebutuhan belajar dan merancang program campuran untuk memenuhinya
- menetapkan hasil belajar dan mengevaluasi dampaknya, bukan hanya kepuasan
- membuat pembelajaran dapat diakses dan inklusif bagi semua staf
levels.expert:
Anda dapat:
- menetapkan strategi dan standar pembelajaran organisasi
- memimpin tawaran pembelajaran, teknologinya, dan pendanaannya
- menunjukkan imbal hasil investasi organisasi dalam pembelajaran

skills.name: Administrasi hukum
skills.description: Menjalankan proses administrasi tim hukum, termasuk pengelolaan perkara, pengendalian dokumen, arsip, tenggat, dan penagihan.

levels.awareness:

- membuka, memperbarui, dan menutup perkara dalam sistem pengelolaan perkara
- mengarsipkan dan mengambil dokumen hukum dengan aman
- menjaga kerahasiaan informasi hukum dan pribadi
levels.working:

- mengelola agenda, tenggat, dan tanggal penting untuk sebuah tim
- menyiapkan dan memformat dokumen hukum, berkas, dan paket penandatanganan
- memeriksa dan memproses faktur pengacara luar
- mengelola register kontrak dan akta
levels.practitioner:
Anda dapat:
- menjalankan administrasi tim hukum dan memperbaiki prosesnya
- melaporkan beban kerja, pengeluaran untuk pengacara luar, dan waktu penyelesaian
- mengadministrasikan teknologi hukum, seperti pengelolaan perkara dan perangkat tanda tangan elektronik
levels.expert:

- merancang model operasi hukum untuk organisasi
- memimpin pemilihan dan penggunaan teknologi hukum
- menetapkan standar layanan dan ukuran kinerja untuk layanan hukum

skills.name: Nasihat hukum
skills.description: Memberi nasihat hukum yang jelas, praktis, dan akurat yang membantu rekan kerja membuat keputusan yang sah dan mengelola risiko hukum.

levels.awareness:
Anda dapat:
- menjelaskan kapan rekan kerja memerlukan nasihat hukum dan cara memperolehnya
- menerima instruksi yang jelas dan mencatat fakta suatu perkara
levels.working:
Anda dapat:
- menyiapkan draf nasihat untuk perkara rutin agar ditinjau pengacara
- menjawab pertanyaan sederhana menggunakan pedoman yang disetujui
- mengidentifikasi isu hukum dalam sekumpulan fakta
levels.practitioner:

occupations.label: ICT system administrator
occupations.description: ICT system administrators are responsible for the upkeep, configuration, and reliable operation of computer and network systems, servers, workstations and peripheral devices. They may acquire, install, or upgrade computer components and software; automate routine tasks; write computer programs; troubleshoot; train and supervise staff; and provide technical support. They ensure optimum system integrity, security, backup and performance.

optional.label: interact with users to gather requirements
remove computer virus or malware from a computer

occupations.label: product manager
occupations.description: Product managers are responsible for managing the lifecycle of a product. They research and develop new products in addition to managing existing ones through market research and strategic planning. Product managers perform marketing and planning activities to increase profits.

essential.label: combine business technology with user experience
draw conclusions from market research results
organise participation in local or international events

optional.label: create prototype of user experience solutions
integrate marketing strategies with the global strategy
manage the handling of promotional materials

occupations.label: corporate training manager
occupations.description: Corporate training managers coordinate all the training activities and development programmes in a company. They also design and develop new training modules and supervise all the activities related to the planning and delivery of these programmes.

essential.label: monitor developments in field of expertise
promote gender equality in business contexts
provide training in sustainable tourism development and management

optional.label: health and safety in the workplace
plan medium to long term objectives

occupations.label: ICT quality assurance manager
occupations.isco08Label: Software and applications developers and analysts not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: ICT quality assurance managers establish and operate an ICT quality approach through quality management systems, in compliance with internal and external standards and the organisation's culture. They ensure that the management controls are correctly implemented to safeguard asset, data integrity and operations. They focus on the achievement of quality goals, including the maintenance of the external certification according to quality standards and monitor statistics to forecast quality outcomes.

essential.label: attend to detail in preparation for audits

occupations.label: ICT security technician
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology user support technicians
occupations.description: ICT security technicians propose and implement necessary security updates and measures whenever is required. They advise, support, inform and provide training and security awareness.

essential.label: establish an ICT security prevention plan

optional.label: remove computer virus or malware from a computer

occupations.label: web content manager
occupations.description: Web content managers curate or create content for a web platform according to the long-term strategic goals, policies and procedures for an organisation's online content or their customers. They control and monitor compliance with standards, legal and privacy regulations and ensure web optimisation. They are also responsible for integrating the work of writers and designers to produce a final layout which is compatible with corporate standards.

occupations.label: ICT product manager
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology service managers
occupations.description: ICT product managers analyse and define current and target status for ICT products, services or solutions. They estimate the cost effectiveness, points of risk, opportunities, strengths and weaknesses of products or services provided. ICT product managers create structured plans and establish time scales and milestones, ensuring optimisation of activities and resources.

essential.label: conduct impact evaluation of ICT processes on business

optional.label: interact with users to gather requirements

occupations.label: ICT help desk agent
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology user support technicians
occupations.description: ICT help desk agents provide technical assistance to computer users, answer questions or solve computer problems for clients via telephone or electronically. They provide assistance concerning the use of computer hardware and software.

essential.label: keep up to date on product knowledge

occupations.label: statistician
occupations.description: Statisticians collect, tabulate, and, most importantly, analyse quantitative information coming from a varied array of fields. They interpret and analyse statistical studies on fields such as health, demographics, finance, business, etc. and advise based on patterns and drawn analysis.

essential.label: apply research ethics and scientific integrity principles in research activities
develop professional network with researchers and scientists
disseminate results to the scientific community
draft scientific or academic papers and technical documentation
increase the impact of science on policy and society
interact professionally in research and professional environments
manage findable accessible interoperable and reusable data
promote the participation of citizens in scientific and research activities

optional.label: teach in academic or vocational contexts

occupations.label: payroll clerk
occupations.description: Payroll clerks manage the time sheets and pay checks of the employees and ensure the accuracy and correctness of the information. They check overtime, sick days and vacations and distribute the pay checks.

occupations.label: corporate risk manager
occupations.description: Corporate risk managers identify and assess potential threats and opportunities to a company, and give advice on how to deal with them. They create preventive plans to avoid and reduce risks, and put plans in place for when the company is threatened. They coordinate risk management aspects across the different functions of an organisation and are responsible for technical activities such as risk assessment, risk mapping and insurance purchase. They report on risk issues to the senior management and the company's board.

optional.label: identify if a company is a going concern
keep updated on the political landscape

occupations.label: database developer
occupations.description: Database developers program, implement and coordinate changes to computer databases based on their expertise of database management systems.

essential.label: data extraction, transformation and loading tools

occupations.label: ICT application developer
occupations.description: ICT application developers implement the ICT (software) applications based on the designs provided using application domain specific languages, tools, platforms and experience.

optional.label: adapt to changes in technological development plans

occupations.label: project manager
occupations.isco08Label: Business services and administration managers not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: Project managers oversee the project on a daily basis and are responsible for delivering high-quality results within the identified objectives and constraints, ensuring the effective use of the allocated resources. They are responsible for risk and issue management, project communication and stakeholder management. Project managers perform the activities of planning, organising, securing, monitoring and managing the resources and work necessary to deliver specific project goals and objectives in an effective and efficient way.

optional.label: find a replacement for stage manager
manage standard enterprise resource planning system

occupations.label: accounting assistant
occupations.description: Accounting assistants record and report ticketing accounting situations to the accountant they work with, verify deposits and prepare daily reports and income. They arrange authorised refund vouchers, maintain the returned check accounts and communicate with ticketing managers concerning about any issues with ticketing systems.

essential.label: attach accounting certificates to accounting transactions

occupations.label: public relations officer
occupations.description: Public relations officers represent a company or organisation to stakeholders and the public. They use communications strategies to promote an understanding of the activities and image of their clients in a favourable way.

essential.label: integrate strategic foundation in daily performance

optional.label: ethics of sharing work through social media

occupations.label: web developer
occupations.description: Web developers develop, implement and document web-accessible software based on the designs provided. They align the client's web presence with its business strategy, troubleshoot software problems and issues and look for ways to improve the application.

optional.label: adapt to changes in technological development plans

occupations.label: programme manager
occupations.description: Programme managers coordinate and oversee several projects working simultaneously. They ensure workability and compatibility among projects ensuring that overall, each one of the projects under the management of project managers, turn out profitable and leveraging one to the other.

essential.label: utilise economies of scale in projects

optional.label: analyse financial performance of a company
integrate headquarter's guidelines into local operations
shape organisational teams based on competencies

occupations.label: procurement support officer
occupations.description: Procurement support officers assist the staff of the procurement team throughout the procurement processes, making sure all procurement documents are compliant with procedural, technical and legal requirements, and that meetings and other contacts are well organised.

essential.label: adhere to organisational code of ethics

optional.label: develop performance orientation in public administration

occupations.label: public procurement specialist
occupations.description: Public procurement specialists are full-time public procurement practitioners working as part of a procurement team in a large organisation or central purchasing body in all phases of the procurement cycle. They translate needs into contracts and deliver value for money for the organisation and the public.

essential.label: adhere to organisational code of ethics
develop performance orientation in public administration

optional.label: create a work atmosphere of continuous improvement
monitor developments in field of expertise

occupations.label: cloud DevOps engineer
occupations.description: Cloud DevOps engineers implement and manage continuous software delivery systems and methodologies. This includes managing and configuring code repositories, build services, automated testing, and deployment mechanisms. For cloud-based workloads, a Cloud DevOps Engineer define and deploy infrastructure as code, automating test and development environments. They can define and configure automated disaster recovery solutions that meet business objectives.

occupations.label: communication manager
occupations.description: Communication managers are responsible for developing communication strategies in order to promote the organization's mission, services or product. They coordinate communication projects and manage the communications issued by the company for both the internal and the external clients. They supervise internal communications, ensuring that communications reach each one of the employees and further questions can be answered. For external communications, they coordinate coherence among the messages transmitted in mails, printed materials, press articles, and corporate promotional materials. They strive to maintain truthful communications.

essential.label: ethics of sharing work through social media
integrate strategic foundation in daily performance
organise participation in local or international events

occupations.label: ICT network engineer
occupations.description: ICT network engineers implement, maintain and support computer networks. They also perform network modelling, analysis, and planning. They may also design network and computer security measures. They may research and recommend network and data communications hardware and software.

optional.label: adapt to changes in technological development plans
remove computer virus or malware from a computer

occupations.label: software architect
occupations.description: Software architects create the technical design and the functional model of a software system, based on functional specifications. They also design the architecture of the system or different modules and components related to the business' or customer requirements, technical platform, computer language or development environment.

occupations.label: human resources officer
occupations.description: Human resources officers develop and implement strategies that help their employers select and retain appropriately qualified staff within that business sector. They recruit staff, prepare job advertisements, interview and short-list people, negotiate with employment agencies, and set up working conditions. Human resources officers also administer the payroll, review salaries and advise on remuneration benefits and employment law. They arrange for training opportunities to enhance employees' performance.

optional.label: ensure gender equality in the workplace
personal reflection techniques based on feedback
support employability of people with disabilities

occupations.label: data analyst
occupations.description: Data analysts import, inspect, clean, transform, validate, model, or interpret collections of data with regard to the business goals of the company. They ensure that the data sources and repositories provide consistent and reliable data. Data analysts use different algorithms and IT tools as demanded by the situation and the current data. They might prepare reports in the form of visualisations such as graphs, charts, and dashboards.

occupations.label: human resources assistant
occupations.description: Human resources assistants provide support in all the processes and efforts carried by human resources managers. They help in the preparation of recruitment processes by scanning CVs and narrowing the selection to the most suitable candidates. They perform administrative tasks, prepare communications and letters, and perform the tabulation of the surveys and assessments carried out by the department.

optional.label: ensure gender equality in the workplace
support employability of people with disabilities

occupations.label: ICT network architect
occupations.description: ICT network architects design the topology and connectivity of ICT network such as hardware, infrastructure, communication and hardware components.

occupations.label: ICT system architect
occupations.description: ICT system architects design architecture, components, modules, interfaces, and data for a multi-components system to meet specified requirements.

occupations.label: accountant
occupations.description: Accountants review and analyse financial statements, budgets, financial reports, and business plans in order to check for irregularities resulting from error or fraud, and provide their clients with financial advice in matters such as financial forecasting and risk analysis. They may audit financial data, resolve insolvency cases, prepare tax returns and provide other tax-related advice in reference to current legislation.

essential.label: analyse financial performance of a company
attach accounting certificates to accounting transactions

occupations.label: document management officer
occupations.isco08Label: Professional services managers not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: Document management officers ensure that the documents required for their organisation's functioning and daily operations are registered, classified and archived correctly and are made available to the different services or to the public upon request. They oversee the implementation of internal procedures and promote proper document management practices within the organisation, providing training to other employees on document management procedures. They may operate electronic records management systems (ERMS), electronic document management systems (EDMS) and archives management systems (AMS) and provide support in defining related technical requirements.

essential.label: monitor developments in field of expertise

optional.label: propose ICT solutions to business problems

occupations.label: clinical informatics manager
occupations.description: Clinical informatics managers oversee the daily operations of information systems used in a medical institutions. They also carry out research, using their understanding of clinical practices to find ways to improve healthcare services.

essential.label: comply with quality standards related to healthcare practice
contribute to continuity of health care
use foreign languages for health-related research

comply with legislation related to health care
conditions for professional practice of clinical psychology
data extraction, transformation and loading tools
inform policy makers on health-related challenges
participate in medical records' auditing activities

occupations.label: ICT operations manager
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology service managers
occupations.description: ICT operations managers coordinate ICT services and infrastructure ensuring that the organisation has the required infrastructural resources. They also plan and monitor stages of either a business process or a computer process, negotiate contracts and take mitigation action in case of non-fulfilment of agreements. They oversee the day-to-day tasks involving infrastructure components, ICT systems and software.

occupations.label: software developer
occupations.description: Software developers implement or program all kinds of software systems based on specifications and designs by using programming languages, tools, and platforms.

optional.label: adapt to changes in technological development plans

occupations.label: human resources manager
occupations.description: Human resources managers plan, design and implement processes related to the human capital of companies. They develop programs for recruiting, interviewing, and selecting employees based on a previous assessment of the profile and skills required in the company. Moreover, they manage compensation and development programs for the company's employees comprising trainings, skill assessment and yearly evaluations, promotion, expat programs, and general assurance of the well-being of the employees in the workplace.

plan medium to long term objectives
promote gender equality in business contexts
support employability of people with disabilities

optional.label: create a work atmosphere of continuous improvement
manage stress in the work place
provide advice on breaches of regulation

occupations.label: user experience analyst
occupations.description: User experience analysts assess client interaction and experience and analyse users' behaviours, attitudes, and emotions about the usage of a particular product, system or service. They make proposals for the improvement of the interface and usability of products, systems or services. In doing so, they take into consideration the practical, experiential, affective, meaningful and valuable aspects of human–computer interaction and product ownership, as well as the person's perceptions of system aspects such as utility, ease of use and efficiency, and user experience dynamics.

essential.label: assess users' interaction with ICT applications
create prototype of user experience solutions

occupations.label: corporate lawyer
occupations.description: Corporate lawyers provide legal consulting services and representation to corporations and organisations. They give advice on matters relating to taxes, legal rights and patents, international trade, trademarks, and legal financial issues arising from operating a business.

occupations.label: ICT business analyst
occupations.description: ICT business analysts are in charge of analysing and designing an organisation's processes and systems, assessing the business model and its integration with technology. They also identify change needs, assess the impact of the change, capture and document requirements and then ensure that these requirements are delivered whilst supporting the business through the implementation process.

essential.label: analyse the context of an organisation
interact with users to gather requirements
propose ICT solutions to business problems

roles.title: Pengembang perangkat lunak
roles.summary: Pengembang perangkat lunak membangun, menguji, dan memelihara perangkat lunak di balik layanan kesehatan digital organisasi, seperti aplikasi untuk pasien, sistem klinis, layanan integrasi, dan platform data. Mereka bekerja dalam tim produk multidisiplin, menulis kode yang aman, terjamin keamanannya, dapat diakses, dan mudah dipelihara, serta mendukung layanan mereka dalam operasi langsung.
healthContext: Perangkat lunak dapat memengaruhi perawatan pasien, sehingga pengembang mengikuti proses manajemen risiko klinis dan menyumbang bukti untuk kasus keselamatan.
Kode sering menangani informasi kesehatan yang rahasia, sehingga pengembang menerapkan tata kelola informasi dan praktik pengodean yang aman sebagai bawaan.
Banyak layanan bertukar data dengan sistem kesehatan dan perawatan lain, menggunakan standar interoperabilitas terbuka seperti HL7 FHIR.
Sebagian perangkat lunak dapat diatur sebagai alat kesehatan, sehingga pengembang perlu tahu kapan harus meminta nasihat regulasi.

pcfRole.name: Software developer
pcfRole.description:
A software developer designs, runs and improves software that meets user needs.

In this role, you will:
- be responsible for writing clean, secure code following a test-driven approach
- create code that is open by default and easy for others to reuse

levels.title: Pengembang perangkat lunak magang
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
An apprentice developer attends certified training and develops skills on the job.

At this role level, you will:
- spend a substantial portion of time shadowing others
- work with other developers to write code and tests
- build your knowledge
- follow a test-driven approach
- write code that is automatically tested
responsibilities: Mempelajari bahasa pemrograman, perangkat, dan cara kerja tim melalui pelatihan terstruktur dan kerja berpasangan.
Menulis dan menguji potongan kode kecil yang terdefinisi dengan baik di bawah pengawasan ketat.
Mengikuti prosedur pengodean aman, tata kelola informasi, dan keselamatan klinis.
Ikut serta dalam seremoni tim seperti stand-up, perencanaan, dan retrospektif.
Bekerja menuju kualifikasi magang atau yang setara.
qualifications: Terdaftar pada, atau sedang menempuh, program magang pengembangan perangkat lunak atau yang setara.
levels.jobEvaluationNotes: Pengetahuan dinilai pada tingkat yang dibutuhkan pekerjaan setelah pelatihan cukup lengkap untuk melakukan pekerjaan; sumber daya informasi mencerminkan pekerjaan pada sistem yang dirancang orang lain.

levels.title: Pengembang perangkat lunak junior
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A junior developer learns on the job by delivering software components.

At this role level, you will:
- develop skills while working under supervision to deliver stories in a multidisciplinary team
- understand and be proficient in different types of testing
- be aware of but not responsible for security
- coach and mentor more junior colleagues
responsibilities: Membangun dan menguji fitur untuk produk tim, bekerja dari cerita pengguna dengan bimbingan.
Menulis pengujian otomatis dan memperbaiki cacat, termasuk pada layanan yang mendukung perawatan pasien.
Menyumbang bukti untuk kasus keselamatan klinis, seperti hasil pengujian dan catatan perubahan.
Menangani data kesehatan dengan aman, mengikuti aturan tata kelola informasi.
Mendukung layanan langsung, dengan bimbingan, sebagai bagian dari pengaturan dukungan tim.
qualifications: Gelar di bidang komputasi atau bidang terkait, magang yang telah selesai, atau pengalaman yang setara.

levels.title: Pengembang perangkat lunak
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A developer delivers software components that form part of a product.

At this role level, you will:
- develop software to meet user needs
- follow best practice guidelines and help to improve those guidelines
- write clean, secure and well-tested code
- coach and mentor more junior colleagues
- operate the services you build and identify issues in production
responsibilities: Merancang, membangun, dan menguji fitur dan layanan secara mandiri, memilih pendekatan yang sesuai.
Meninjau kode dan membantu menjaga standar rekayasa tim.
Membangun integrasi dengan sistem kesehatan dan perawatan lain menggunakan standar terbuka seperti HL7 FHIR.
Ikut serta dalam identifikasi bahaya dan membantu memasukkan pengendalian keselamatan klinis ke dalam kode dan pengujian.
Menyelidiki dan memperbaiki masalah pada layanan langsung, termasuk dukungan di luar jam kerja jika layanan memerlukannya.
Membimbing pengembang junior dan magang.
qualifications: Gelar di bidang komputasi atau bidang terkait, atau pengalaman yang setara.
Pengalaman membangun dan mendukung perangkat lunak produksi.

levels.title: Pengembang perangkat lunak senior
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A senior developer delivers and integrates software to form a complete service.

At this role level, you will:
- plan and lead development on sets of related stories
- have an understanding of the whole system and take responsibility for teaching this to others
- work with other disciplines to understand what needs to be built
- coach and mentor more junior colleagues
- operate the production services you build
- find ways to improve system robustness, resilience and stability
There are 2 different roles at this level - a technical role and a management role.
responsibilities: Memimpin desain teknis dan penyampaian fitur dan layanan yang signifikan.
Menetapkan dan memelihara standar rekayasa untuk tim, termasuk pengujian, keamanan, dan aksesibilitas.
Mengambil keputusan teknis yang menyeimbangkan kebutuhan pengguna, keselamatan klinis, keamanan, dan biaya.
Memimpin penyelidikan insiden untuk layanan tim dan mendorong perbaikannya.
Bekerja dengan petugas keselamatan klinis untuk memastikan pengendalian keselamatan dirancang dan diuji.
Membimbing dan mengembangkan para pengembang dalam tim.
qualifications: Pengalaman yang substansial dalam merancang, membangun, dan mendukung perangkat lunak produksi, pada tingkat yang setara dengan gelar magister.

levels.title: Pengembang perangkat lunak pimpinan
levels.pcfLevelDescription:
A lead developer leads development on one or a small number of related project teams.

At this role level, you will:
- guide the ways in which the team works
- be proficient in a wide range of technical systems
- be involved in identifying appropriate technology and approaches, deciding when software should be written
- contribute to the developer community
- provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring your team
- promote knowledge sharing and adoption of good practice
There are 2 different roles at this level - a technical role and a management role.
responsibilities: Memimpin rekayasa untuk sebuah produk atau kelompok tim, menetapkan arah teknis.
